entities.summary: Lars Barfoed is a Danish politician representing the Conservative People's Party and was the party's leader from 2011 to 6 August 2014. He was Justice Minister of Denmark from February 2010 to October 2011, and Deputy Prime Minister of Denmark from January to October 2011. He also served as Minister for Family and Consumer Affairs from 18 February 2005 to 14 December 2006.
